title: NFIB: August 2026 jobs report
method: Survey of NFIB members; seasonally adjusted indicators.
limitations: Membership-based sample. The 5,000-member sampling frame is not a completed-response count; difficulty is not a vacancy total.

title: ManpowerGroup: 2026 talent shortage survey
method: Employer survey: over 39,000 employers in 41 countries.
limitations: Reported hiring difficulty across different labor markets; not an objective global skills deficit or US vacancy rate.

title: BLS: electricians
limitations: Openings include growth, occupational transfers and labor-force exits. Projections are not observed vacancies; wages exclude the self-employed.

title: BLS: accountants and auditors
limitations: Broad occupation, not CPAs alone; projected openings are not a measured shortage.

title: BLS: home health and personal care aides
limitations: Large occupation with substantial turnover and demand growth. National averages hide local conditions.

title: AICPA: 2025 Trends findings
method: Professional-body report using education data and a firm survey.
limitations: Low firm response prevented a national hiring projection. Degrees, people and CPA licenses are different measures.

title: AICPA: the new CPA exam, two years in
method: Professional-body account citing National Student Clearinghouse data.
limitations: Enrollment is a leading indicator, not graduates or licensed accountants; recovery can take years to reach employers.

title: ILO–NASK: generative AI and jobs, 2025 update
limitations: Potential exposure is not observed automation, unemployment or a forecast of jobs eliminated.

title: Brynjolfsson, Li & Raymond: Generative AI at Work
method: Staggered workplace rollout; journal abstract and institutional record.
limitations: One customer-support setting; nonrandom rollout. Use the published 15% estimate rather than mixing earlier working-paper versions.

title: Siemens and Microsoft scale industrial AI
limitations: More than 100 customers were reported; 120,000 TIA Portal engineers were eligible, not active copilot users. Claims lack a controlled time study.

title: Anthropic: AI assistance and coding-skill formation
method: Randomized study of 52 mostly junior engineers learning Trio.
limitations: Immediate quiz after a short task, not long-term career outcomes. Usage-pattern subgroup comparisons are observational.

title: BLS: accountants’ occupational requirements
published_or_version: 2025 Occupational Requirements Survey; current factsheet accessed September 21, 2026
method: Official job requirements for accountants and auditors.
limitations: Percentages describe jobs requiring prior experience or on-the-job training, not the share of workers lacking skills or the duration of onboarding.
